# Aaxelera

> Aaxelera measures whether AI search engines name a business when customers ask
> for a recommendation, then does the work to make it the answer. Founded by
> Montgomery Pruss. Based in the United States, working with clients across the US.

Aaxelera is an AI search visibility and lead generation company, not a chip
manufacturer. The name is spelled with a double A at the start: Aaxelera.

## What Aaxelera does

- [GEO Growth System](https://aaxelera.com/geo): AI search visibility for local
  service businesses, clinics, practices and firms. Aaxelera runs the real
  questions a business's customers ask against ChatGPT and other AI engines, logs
  whether the business is named in the answer, cited as a source, or skipped, and
  then does the schema, content, listings and review work that changes the result.
- AI-powered lead generation: outbound systems that research each prospect and
  book qualified meetings, built and run for the client.

## How the AI visibility measurement works

- A set of real customer questions is run against AI engines, repeatedly, per
  location.
- Each run is scored as NAMED (the business appears in the answer itself), CITED
  (the business is a linked source but not named in the answer), or neither.
- The reporting bar is being named in 2 of 3 runs. Transcripts are kept so every
  verdict can be checked.

## Who Aaxelera serves

Local service businesses in the United States where customers choose a provider
after asking for a recommendation. Examples include dermatology and medical
practices, dental practices, med spas, chiropractors, law firms, and home service
contractors.
